description:
Make the docs describe the repo as it IS. Stale, dead and duplicated documentation is archived or corrected — never silently deleted.

MEASURED IN THIS REPO ON 2026-09-03: **1 dead internal `.md` link(s)** measured on 2026-09-03; **5 of 24 docs carry no `Status · Updated · Owner` banner**.

DEPENDS ON THE CODE SWEEP, DELIBERATELY. Removing dead code changes what the docs should say, so documenting first means documenting twice.

THE STANDARD IS ALREADY WRITTEN AND IS NOT THIS TASKLIST'S TO INVENT: five root files, seven directories under `docs/` (`tutorials` `guides` `reference` `explanation` `decisions` `runbooks` `archive`), `docs/README.md` links every document, every file opens with a `Status · Updated · Owner` banner, and **nothing is deleted — it is archived** with a note saying what replaced it. Spec: `rosetta/docs/reference/documentation-standard.md`.

ROADMAPS ARE OUT OF SCOPE. `ROADMAP.md` and the roadmap plans under `docs/*/roadmap/` were reconciled portfolio-wide on 2026-09-02/03 and state their own evidence standard. Do not re-mark them here.

ARCHIVE, DO NOT DELETE. The standard says so and this portfolio has paid for the alternative: five consolidated strategy documents were unrecoverable except through one paragraph of prose. An archived doc with a note saying what replaced it costs nothing and answers the question a reader will actually have.

userStories.title: Every document is reachable, banner-stamped, and in the right place
userStories.notes: docs/README.md links every one of the 25 docs/ files (reachability check: 0 UNLINKED); every one carries a single-line `Status · Updated · Owner` banner (banner check: 0 NO BANNER, was 6 — plan-review, concurrency, overlap-zones, provider-unavailability, usage had none, and dead-code-audit 's spanned three lines so it did not read as one). check-doc-links.mjs: 0 dead references, 0 distinct targets. The one dead .md link found by a wider scan than the gate runs (the gate skips `..`-escaping paths) was docs/README.md -> ../../rosetta/docs/reference/documentation-standard.md, which resolves from no chief worktree; it is now cited by path. ROADMAP.md -> ../AGENTIC-ENGINEERING-ADVISORY.md is the other and was left alone — roadmaps are out of scope for this tasklist. Structure: 4 of the standard's 7 directories present, none outside the vocabulary; the two docs/-root files are now a declared exception in docs/README.md with its cost stated. Gate: chief verify green.
acceptanceCriteria: Dead internal links are repaired or the target is archived with a pointer. A link to a document that no longer exists is worse than no link: it asserts the document is current.

Every `docs/` file carries a `Status · Updated · Owner` banner. Where a doc is stale rather than current, the banner is where that gets SAID — `Status: Superseded` with what replaced it beats a silent edit.
`docs/README.md` links every document. Unlinked is unreachable, and unreachable documentation still greps as current — which is how a reader finds it and believes it.
Directories outside the standard's seven are either justified in writing as declared exceptions or their contents are moved. Do not move a directory other files cite without repointing them.
GATES: the repo's own verify green.

userStories.title: Content that describes a tree that moved
userStories.notes: Measured drift first, then corrected only what the measurement showed; every count below was re-run on this tree. EVENTS: docs/reference/events.md documented 33 of the 41 event types the engine emits (diffed every `event_emit` literal in bin/+engine/ against the doc, plus the two variable-emit tables — driver.sh's worker_park $ev and mergequeue.sh); the 8 missing are story.unverified, tasklist.{queued,unsatisfiable,terminal-negative,decision,awaiting-decision,decision-declined,awaiting-approval}. Now 41/41. Also corrected there: "one file per run" — chief decide and chief retire --negative write decisions.events.jsonl / retirements.events.jsonl, which `chief events -l` lists in the run-id column. SCHEMA: docs/reference/tasklist-schema.md named `category` ZERO times though 46 of this repo's 47 tasklists carry it and scripts/check-tasklist-categories.mjs blocks a merge without it; documented, with chief-holds-no-vocabulary vs the per-repo gate kept distinct. Same file stated the DECISION/research note TWICE in two wordings that had begun to disagree (Set/Use review:"decision") — reduced to one. PROVIDERS: docs/guides/providers.md counted four providers; codex was promoted 2026-08-19 and its roster table was updated then while the prose was not (3 sites), and its README link pointed at ../README.md = docs/README.md, not the repo README. DUPLICATION THAT DISAGREED: the verdict-cache key is 4 components (tree.base.hook.subs) and README.md + CLAUDE.md both still said 3; corrected, with verify-hook.md cited as the single home. CLAUDE.md LAYOUT: missing 13 of 33 engine/ files (budget cigate concurrency gen preset quality repeat retire review terminal zones + instructions.md plan-instructions.md) and 7 of 23 bin/chief subcommands (events usage quality cigate retire approve decide); both filled in, plus templates/ (+quality.conf +zones.conf), .chief/ (+quality.conf) and the docs/ block rewritten to the actual Diataxis tree. BANNERS: 6 Updated stamps were older than the last change to what the document says, by up to 3 weeks; restamped from git. Rule stated in docs/README.md: a path-only link repair is not a content change, which is why 4 files still read 2026-08-14. Corrections are dated in-place under each banner (> **Corrected 2026-09-04**) and indexed in a new "Corrections of record" section in docs/README.md, which also records the 4 engine/bin copies of the 3-component key left alone (test/version-bump.sh path-scopes engine/+bin/, so a comment fix there owes a VERSION bump no consumer can act on). ROADMAP.md gained the row 121's merge owed it — main was RED on doc-sync without it, not a re-marking of any roadmap plan. CODE SWEEP REFLECTED: 900 removed exactly two things — crossrepo_completed() and CHIEF_SWEEP_STARTUP_BYTES/_COUNT. Both are named in docs ONLY inside docs/explanation/dead-code-audit.md, whose §§2-5 are deliberately left AS MEASURED with §8 recording the disposition; that is history, not drift, and it stays. Verified mechanically that no doc cites code that no longer exists: every `(engine|test|scripts|templates|bin|docs|tasks)/...` path and every `fn()` in docs resolves in the tree (96 paths, 1 unresolved and it is crossrepo_completed inside the audit), and of the CHIEF_* identifiers docs mention only that removed pair is absent from the code. GATES, measured on this tree: `chief verify` exit 0, GREEN, verdict RECORDED — PATH-SCOPED, and honestly so: the diff is docs + tasklists only, so the hook ran doc-links (0 dead vs 0 on main), doc-sync (PASS, v0.9.22, 46 merged tasklists, README covers every bin/chief subcommand), tasklist jq parse and category coverage (OK), and did NOT run the shell/behavioural block because nothing under engine/ or bin/ changed. Separately run by hand: scripts/check-doc-links.mjs 0 dead references (0 distinct targets); test/doc-sync.sh PASS (v0.9.22, 46 merged tasklists, README covers every subcommand); check-tasklist-categories.mjs OK; quality ratchet OK, no tracked metric regressed; all 25 docs banner-stamped and linked from docs/README.md (0 NO BANNER, 0 UNLINKED).
acceptanceCriteria: Read the docs against the tree and correct what has drifted — paths, commands, module names, counts, and any claim the code no longer supports. This is the half a link-checker cannot do and the half that actually misleads.
Anything the code sweep removed is reflected here. A doc describing deleted code is the most confidently wrong kind.

Duplicated documentation — the same fact stated in two places that can disagree — is reduced to one home with the other pointing at it. Two copies of one fact is the same defect as two implementations of one behaviour.
Corrections are DATED and say what was wrong, in the house style used by this portfolio's corrections of record. A silently fixed doc teaches nobody why it drifted.
GATES: the repo's own verify green.

userStories.title: Archived, not deleted — and the record says why
userStories.notes: ARCHIVED, not deleted: exactly one document was superseded and it moved — CHANGELOG.md's content to docs/archive/changelog-2026-08-21.md (a new directory; docs/ now uses 5 of the standard's 7). Verbatim, with the measurement that found it: 0 commits have touched CHANGELOG.md since 2026-08-21 and 15 of 15 tasklists merged in that span (108-concurrency-is-machine-wide .. 900-dead-code-paydown) added no line, while ROADMAP.md — which test/doc-sync.sh fails CI over — stayed correct across the same fifteen. Its three entries were never wrong, only mis-filed under `## Unreleased`: all three shipped in v0.8.82 (merge 522ee4c, 2026-08-21) and `chief list --all`, `chief list --plain`, `chief ps --all` all still exist in bin/chief. The root CHANGELOG.md still EXISTS (Tier 1 root file where a repo ships, and chief ships via install.sh/chief update) and is now a pointer to ROADMAP.md + tasks/chief/completed/ + the archive. The archive note also states what reinstating a hand-maintained changelog would cost (a gate shaped like doc-sync's, or the next fifteen merges do what the last fifteen did). LEFT ALONE, with reasons recorded in docs/README.md: dead-code-audit.md (acted on by 900, but it is both an approved measurement record and live guidance — §3 Class B do-not-remove, §5 proved-absent so the next sweep skips them, §§9-10 undecidable+limits); both ADRs (immutable; the conflict-predictor one records a decline "for now" that the next proposal must read); tasks/chief/completed/ (history, and the link gate skips it as a citer by design); ROADMAP.md and the roadmap plans incl. its dead ../AGENTIC-ENGINEERING-ADVISORY.md link (out of scope by the brief); the four engine/bin copies of the 3-component cache key (already recorded). One standard violation WAS fixed rather than left: both ADRs carried their work state as a SECOND `**Status:**` line under the document banner — the exact field-name collision rosetta's standard R2 names — relabelled to `**Phase:**`, bodies untouched, each carrying a dated `> **Corrected 2026-09-04**` note saying so. NOT VERIFIED, stated in docs/README.md because silence would read as a claim the docs are now true: no procedure in any guide was executed (commands/flags/paths were checked to EXIST, which is not the same as behaving as described); ~6,900 lines of prose with no symbol in it was read, not proved; dated measurements were not re-measured; the nine URL occurrences (six distinct) were not checked, the link gate being local-only by design; prose outside docs/ (engine/instructions.md, plan-instructions.md, templates/agent-context.md, .chief/agent-context.md, examples/minimal/, ci.yml comments, bin/engine header comments) was not audited; no cross-repo claims exist to check (no .chief/claims.json here). GATES, measured on this tree: `chief verify` exit 0, GREEN, verdict RECORDED — path-scoped and honestly so (docs + tasklist only, so the shell/behavioural block did not run, nothing under engine/ or bin/ changed). Separately by hand: scripts/check-doc-links.mjs 0 dead references (0 distinct targets); test/doc-sync.sh PASS (v0.9.22, 46 merged tasklists, README covers every subcommand); check-tasklist-categories.mjs OK; all 26 docs/ files banner-stamped (0 NO BANNER) and linked from docs/README.md (0 UNLINKED).
acceptanceCriteria: Superseded documents move to `docs/archive/` with a note naming what replaced them and when. Nothing is deleted outright.
Report what was left alone and why — a doc that looks stale but is the record of a decision is not stale, it is history, and this portfolio keeps those deliberately.
State honestly what this sweep did NOT verify. Documentation correctness is not machine-checkable in general, and a claim that the docs are now true is stronger than the method supports.
GATES: the repo's own verify green.
